data.one_liner: Dead code detector for Dart and Flutter that finds and removes unused declarations.
data.what_it_does: Analyzes Dart and Flutter source code to find unused classes, functions, methods, fields, and enum values. It can generate reports in various formats or automatically remove the dead code.
use_when: Cleaning up legacy codebases and removing obsolete classes or functions
Integrating dead code detection into CI pipelines to prevent accumulation of unused code
avoid_when: Working with heavy reflection or dynamic invocation patterns that cannot be statically resolved
Relying fully on automated removal without manual review
strengths: Supports automatic removal of found dead code with interactive prompts or force options
Understands framework entry points, generated files, and avoids many false positives
Integrates into multiple CI formats like GitHub Actions, Azure, and SARIF
weaknesses: Static heuristic-based analysis can still yield false positives requiring manual code review
May struggle to detect references used only through dynamic code or complex reflection
data.setup_notes: Install as a global tool or add as a dev dependency in pubspec.yaml and run dart run ciach.
